updates.text: Imported all 51 findings, 21 ticket drafts and 35 screenshots. Recorded the code-review notes and agreed direction. Implementation and planning have not started.
Started batch 01 after owner approval. Captured baseline screenshots at 390 and 1440 px; completion requires matching after screenshots and acceptance evidence.

Added explicit batch acceptance checklists without changing the original ticket drafts. T-13 removes search from the Ask flow while keeping keyword search separately in Wardrobe. T-15 and T-05 retain rotation, countdown and recognition follow-ups. Every completed ticket now requires before/after image pairs.

Captured and visually reviewed nine before/after pairs (18 images) from synthetic fixtures. All 755 unit tests passed; native acceptance is running. Tracker image loading, 320/390/1440 px layouts, search and no-JavaScript comparisons passed.

Full batch gate passed on c05071e: 755 unit tests and 29 native tests (1,276 assertions). Native journeys verified chat entry/resumption, saving from the compact board action and finishing paired capture. The preview deployment is next.

Deployed batch c05071e to the isolated preview and passed exact-release readback (3 tests, 42 assertions). Closed T-13 and verified F-10, F-23, F-39, F-44 and F-47. T-15/T-05 remain partial; F-42 awaits dense-metadata phone review and F-50 retains recognition work. Nine before/after pairs are attached to the tickets.

Started board batch 02: T-04 layering, T-09 direct editing and canvas placement, T-11 filtered piece sheet. Matching synthetic baseline screenshots captured at 390 and 1440 px. No ticket is marked complete.

Board batch 02 passed the completed full gate: 759 unit tests and 29 native tests / 1,284 assertions. Six matching before/after pairs are attached. T-04, T-09 and T-11 await exact-release preview readback before closure.

Deployed board batch 021dabe to the isolated preview and passed exact-release smoke acceptance (3 tests / 42 assertions). Closed T-04, T-09 and T-11; independently verified F-19, F-20, F-36 and F-37. Six comparison pairs are attached, bringing the tracker to 15 pairs. Camera recognition/countdown and piece rotation remain open in T-05/T-15.

Started camera batch 03 after owner approval: visible countdown, dark/uniform-frame guard, motion cancellation and explicit Back pairing. T-21 reviewed at c95185b: wardrobe signed pictures are deployed, but remaining media kinds and authenticated performance acceptance are open.
